name: get_total_balance
description: The user's total portfolio value plus a per-token breakdown of every non-zero holding.

name: get_balance
description: Balance and value of the given tokens only.

name: get_user_info
description: The user's profile, verification level and account settings.

name: get_deposit_address
description: The user's deposit address for a token on a network, creating one if needed.

name: get_profit_and_loss
description: Realized and unrealized profit and loss, for all assets or the given tokens.

name: get_transactions
description: Recent deposits, withdrawals, transfers and trades, newest first.

name: get_contacts
description: The user's saved SwapWallet contacts, ten per page.

name: get_ibans
description: The user's verified bank accounts, usable as a Rial withdrawal destination.

name: get_action_request
description: The current status of a request created by one of the request_* tools: PENDING while the user has not answered, then EXECUTED, REJECTED, EXPIRED or FAILED.

name: request_swap
description: Prices a swap between two tokens and sends it to the user's Telegram for approval.

name: request_transfer
description: Prepares a transfer to another SwapWallet user and sends it to the user's Telegram for approval. The recipient must already be one of the user's contacts.

name: request_crypto_withdraw
description: Prepares a crypto withdrawal and sends it to the user's Telegram for approval. Returns immediately with a pending request; nothing is sent until the user approves. Tell the user to check Telegram, then poll get_action_request.

name: request_fiat_withdraw
description: Prepares a Rial (IRT) withdrawal to one of the user's verified IBANs and sends it to their Telegram for approval. Nothing is paid out until the user approves.
